risk_note: RV2 by path (union). Product cards now carry the adapter's cleaned main image: catalog card-assembler sets image = item.main_image_url ?? null instead of a hard-coded null, never filling it from image_urls; the Pinduoduo adapter maps goods_image_url / goods_gallery_urls on search, recommend and detail rows through normalizeItemImages, never the thumbnail, never passing through same-named upstream fields. No amounts. Taobao official search already maps images and is unchanged.
